raw_segments.text: I mean the present gentleman, Mr. Edward's father," he explained.
Fully assured by these words that Mr. Edward, my Mr. Rochester, God bless him, wherever
he was, was at least alive, was, in short, the present gentleman, gladdening words.
It seemed I could hear all that was to come, whatever the disclosures might be, with comparative
Since he was not in the grave, I could bear, I thought, to learn that he was at the antipodes.
